title: Sanitation Property Damage
categories: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
description: Use this service request to report all property damages ONLY caused by sanitation trucks. For damaged roll carts, use the Sanitation Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery service request. If a customer would like to file a complaint against a sanitation driver/employee, use the Complaint/Compliment – 311 service request type. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

observedQuestions.prompt: Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for property damage caused by a Sanitation truck.
actions.why: Report property damage caused by a Sanitation brush, garbage, or recycling truck. The 311 request form asks what property was damaged, what the damage was, when it occurred, and which Sanitation vehicle was involved.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Sanitation Property Damage" requests is only for property damage caused by Sanitation trucks. If a roll cart is damaged, then submit a "Sanitation Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery" 311 request instead. If the concern is a complaint about a Sanitation driver or employee rather than property damage, then submit a "Complaint/Compliment" 311 request instead.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection" > Choose "Sanitation Property Damage"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection" > Choose "Sanitation Property Damage"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a damaged Sanitation roll cart.
actions.why: For a damaged Sanitation garbage or recycling roll cart. The description for "Sanitation Property Damage" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs damaged roll carts to this service, which handles roll-cart repairs and replacements.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection" > Choose "Sanitation Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection" > Choose "Sanitation Roll Cart Maintenance/Delivery"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 complaint about a Sanitation driver or employee.
actions.why: For a complaint about a Sanitation driver or employee, including employee conduct or unsafe driving. The description for "Sanitation Property Damage" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs driver/employee complaints to this service type.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "Complaint/Compliment"
